features: 4G LTE Connectivity - This 4G LTE Routers offer high-speed Internet access using Cellular Networks. The router includes a SIM card slot where you can insert a mobile data SIM card from a telecom provider. This makes it highly portable and easy to set up in areas with limited wired broadband infrastructure..
Portable and Compact Desgn - This Router is compact and portable, making it ideal for mobile hotspots, or for use in locations without fixed broadband access.
Ethernet Port - In addition to Wi-Fi, this router comes with one Ethernet Port for Wired Connection to Desktops, Printers, or other devices that require a stable and fast connction.
External Antennas - This Router have 4 external Antennas to boost the signal strength, particularly in areas with weak mobile network coverage. These Antennas improves Router's range and stability.
Low Power Consumption - This Router is designed to consume very little power, making it energy efficient for continuous operation.
